notes: Shopify store (0a3faa-40.myshopify.com), Dutch language, robots.txt has no Claude/Anthropic-specific disallow (Sitemap: https://shop.vtwonen.nl/sitemap.xml). Discovery: the live mega-menu (categorieen/ruimtes) currently shows no seasonal branch at all (off-season, Sept 2026) - it lists only room/product-type nav, so Seasonal categories were discovered instead by full enumeration of /collections.json (paginated to true end: 1908 total collections across the store) and scanning every title+handle for Dutch/English holiday vocabulary (kerst/christmas, pasen/paas/easter, valentijn, vaderdag/father's day, moederdag/mother's day, halloween, sinterklaas/pakjesavond, diwali, carnaval, black friday, oud en nieuw/nieuwjaar, sint-maarten, feestdagen, herfst/winter/lente/zomer). Halloween, Sinterklaas, Diwali, New Year, Carnival, and a combined 'Feestdagen' hub are genuinely absent (zero matches) - this site (a Dutch furniture/home-decor retailer) only carries Christmas, Easter, Valentine's Day, Father's Day and Mother's Day as real seasonal categories. Each candidate collection was verified as a genuine PLP (not a pure marketing page) by fetching the live page: all included rows render real, priced products in a product grid, not just editorial copy. Qty method: the theme renders its collection grid asynchronously via a Searchanise-based widget with no on-page 'showing X of Y' total ever surfacing (confirmed via rendered DOM/network capture on two sample pages), and Shopify's own collections.json products_count metafield disagreed with the live catalog by up to ~50 items on some handles (a known-unreliable source per prior site experience) - so qty for every row was established by full pagination of /collections/<handle>/products.json to a genuinely empty page (evidence records the page breakdown); this is the shared core's method 3 (full enumeration), used here because methods 1-2 were not obtainable/trustworthy for this theme. EXCLUDED as marketing/trend/editorial, not genuine seasonal product-type categories (Rule 4/5/6/17): 'Alles voor de feesttafel' (4418 products - generic tableware/entertaining mega-collection, not tied to one named occasion); 'Kerststyling van Kelly' (0 qty, styling-by-influencer editorial), 'vtwonen kerstboek BK1', 'vtwonen kerstcollectie' (own-brand collection name, not a product type), 'vtwonen Landelijk 11 2025 - Kersttafel dekken', 'vtwonen special 4 2025 - Kerst BK1', 'vtwonen special 4 2025 Kerst - 1001 Sfeervol Tafelen' (all magazine-issue/special-edition tie-ins); 'Kerst opbergen' and 'Kerstdorpen' (0 products, dropped per zero-qty rule). Also excluded a cluster of 'summer'/'trend' collections that are seasonal-flavoured marketing campaigns rather than a genuine named-occasion category: 'Eindeloos zomeren', 'Trendcollectie Zomer', 'Trendkleuren herfst/winter 25-26', 'Zen zone' (zomer-zenn), 'Zomerspecial - Genieten van groen', 'Zomerspecial - Take it easy' (relaxen), 'Bubbels en buitenpret' (zomer-vieren), 'Buiten koken & tafelen' (zomerspecial koken&eten), 'Zomers servies & tafeltextiel', 'Zomerse wanddecoraties & spiegels' - none of these are filed by the site under a 'Summer' holiday hub; they are campaign-styled trend/lookbook collections (titles like 'Take it easy', 'Bubbels en buitenpret', 'Zen zone') applying a seasonal color/style theme to otherwise generic product types, matching the loose-seasonal-adjective exclusion rather than a real occasion category, so they were left out rather than silently included.
